IdleTimeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before disconnecting inactive connections

SysopMail.description: Sysop's email address for mail handling

AllowMail.description: Which users are allowed to use axmail (all, nologin, passwd, axhome)

AutoCreate.description: Allow automatic creation of user accounts (yes/no)

LoginAllowed.description: Whether auto-created accounts can log in (yes/no/crazy)

AutoGroup.description: Group name or ID for auto-created accounts

First_uid.description: First user ID to use for auto-created accounts

Last_uid.description: Maximum user ID to use for auto-created accounts

HomeDir.description: Base directory for home directories of new users

FaxGate.description: Fax gateway email address (must be quoted in config)
